$comment: Contract for the UpdateCaseDetails server-side command (AD-003, AD-036, AD-041, command-concurrency skill). Deployed via the registration console (plugins/OutcomeTesting.Registration) and added to the OutcomeTesting solution via a solution-file import (src/customapis/al_UpdateCaseDetails). Custom API parameter Type codes: 0=Boolean, 10=String.

customApi.name: al_UpdateCaseDetails
customApi.description: A manager amends the editable case header (status, review route, priority, due date) with a mandatory reason. Enforces the AD-041 page.cases Edit permission, optimistic concurrency and idempotency, and writes an immutable Audit Event recording the before/after of every changed field (BR-012).

requestParameters.name: TargetId
requestParameters.description: Id of the al_outcomecase to update.

requestParameters.name: Status
requestParameters.description: New al_casestatus option value. Omit to leave the status unchanged.

requestParameters.name: RouteId
requestParameters.description: New al_reviewroute id (the AD-036 Tax/AQS reassignment). Omit to leave the route unchanged.

requestParameters.name: Priority
requestParameters.description: New al_priority option value. Omit to leave the priority unchanged.

requestParameters.name: DueDate
requestParameters.description: New due date (yyyy-MM-dd). Omit to leave the due date unchanged.

requestParameters.name: Fields
requestParameters.description: JSON object of editable al_outcomecase fields keyed by logical name (e.g. {"al_clientname":"A. Client","al_casetype":"120910510"}). Choice fields take the numeric option value, dates yyyy-MM-dd. Only allowlisted fields are accepted; each change is audited. Omit to change nothing here.

requestParameters.name: Reason
requestParameters.description: Mandatory reason for the change, recorded on the Audit Event (BR-012, NFR-AUD-01).

requestParameters.name: ExpectedRowVersion
requestParameters.description: Row version of the case, for optimistic concurrency. Omit to skip the check.

requestParameters.name: IdempotencyKey
requestParameters.description: Stable key for the intent; a replay returns the same result.

responseProperties.name: CaseId
responseProperties.description: Id of the al_outcomecase that was updated.

responseProperties.name: AuditEventId
responseProperties.description: Id of the Audit Event written for this command.

responseProperties.name: Conflict
responseProperties.description: True when the command was rejected for an optimistic-concurrency conflict.
